chunks: Al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, Muḥammad ibn Muslim, Zurārah, and Burayd ibn Muʿāwiyah narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A woman who possesses authority over herself, being neither foolish nor under guardianship, her marriage without a guardian is permissible.

key_terms.السَّفِيهَةِ: one who is foolish or legally incompetent in judgment
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman in question for the legal ruling
key_terms.الْمُوَلَّى عَلَيْهَا: one who is under legal guardianship
key_terms.مَلَكَتْ نَفْسَهَا: having authority and control over her own affairs
key_terms.وَلِيٍّ: guardian with legal authority in marriage

ai.seo_question: Can an adult woman marry without a guardian in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding marriage authority. It states that a woman who is in control of her own affairs, and is neither legally incompetent nor under guardianship, may contract marriage without a guardian.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4397 - It is narrated by Al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, Muhammad ibn Muslim, Zurara, and Burayd ibn Muawiyah from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"A woman who has control over herself, is neither foolish nor under guardianship, her marriage without a guardian is permissible."
